# Digital Wellness Hub — Website Link & Deployment Record

**Project Title:** Digital Wellness Hub | Practical Student Guide & AI Advisor  
**Author / Maintainer:** Yash Khedekar  
**Publication Date:** November 16, 2026  
**Status:** Live & Production Ready  

---

## 1. Primary Access Links

| Asset | Target Link / Identifier | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Production Web Application** | [https://digitalwellness.yashkhedekar.me](https://digitalwellness.yashkhedekar.me) | Primary student-facing domain with SSL/TLS edge delivery via Cloudflare Workers. |
| **Public API Backend** | [https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com](https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com) | FastAPI asynchronous REST service hosted on Render (includes automated OpenAPI documentation). |
| **Interactive API Documentation** | [https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com/docs](https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com/docs) | Swagger UI for exploring and querying interactive schema endpoints. |
| **Source Code Repository** | [https://github.com/Fantom-1/DigitalWellness](https://github.com/Fantom-1/DigitalWellness) | Monorepo containing React/Vite client, FastAPI backend engine, and CI/CD automation pipelines. |

---

## 2. Infrastructure & Hosting Architecture

* **Edge Delivery & CDN:** Cloudflare Workers (Single-Page Application asset routing, HTTP/2 & HTTP/3, zero-cold-start edge caching).
* **Application Server:** Render Web Service (FastAPI running on Python 3.11 with Uvicorn async worker threads).
  * *Note on Inactivity:* Render free tier instances enter idle state after 15 minutes of zero traffic. The initial cold start takes approximately 30–35 seconds, after which responses execute in sub-100ms latencies.
* **Database Management:** PostgreSQL hosted on Supabase with `pgvector` extension configured for vector similarity embeddings.
* **Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD):**
  * Automated push triggers configured via GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`).
  * Automated deployment on all commits to `master` and `main` branches using `cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4` and Node.js 22 LTS.

---

## 3. Core API Endpoints

All endpoints support cross-origin requests (CORS enabled for development and production domains):

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Sample Output / Payload |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/health` | System status and connectivity check | `{"status": "ok", "app": "Digital Wellness Resource Hub"}` |
| `GET` | `/stats` | Aggregate directory counts & student ratings | Total tools count, category distribution, avg student rating |
| `GET` | `/resources` | Filterable list of all 15 wellness resources | Array of resource objects (category, pricing, privacy rating) |
| `GET` | `/resources/{slug}`| Detailed resource profile with tutorial links | Full specifications, limitations, and YouTube guide URLs |
| `GET` | `/guides` | Complete list of student setup guides | Step-by-step setup walkthroughs and JSONB action items |
| `GET` | `/guides/{slug}` | Granular setup protocol | Detailed markdown, platform flags, and video tutorial link |
| `POST` | `/submissions` | Student tool suggestion intake | Payload with tool title, URL, rationale, and student email |
| `POST` | `/chat` | Context-aware AI Advisor consultation | Powered by Google Gemini model with system prompt grounding |

---

## 4. Student User Access Instructions

1. **Browser Compatibility:** Access via any modern desktop or mobile browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Brave).
2. **Authentication:** No registration, login, or personal identifying information is required to access the directory, compare tools, review guides, or converse with the AI Wellness Advisor.
3. **Mobile Usage:** Optimized for touchscreens (320px to 1440px viewport width) with dedicated swipe gestures, sticky comparative tables, and 44px minimum tap targets.

# Digital Wellness Resource Comparison Matrix

**Project:** Digital Wellness Hub  
**Author:** Yash Khedekar  
**Evaluation Scope:** 15 Evidence-Based Student Digital Wellness Applications  
**Date of Audit:** November 16, 2026  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Assessment Methodology

The purpose of this comparative analysis is to evaluate digital wellness interventions across criteria critical to higher education students: **cross-platform ubiquity**, **academic budget sustainability**, **data privacy governance**, **bypass-resistance**, and **friction design**.

The 15 evaluated resources are distributed evenly across five functional categories:
1. **Focus Blockers** (Deep work session enforcement)
2. **Screen Time Diagnostics & Interventions** (Conscious friction & awareness)
3. **Browser Extensions** (Algorithmic decluttering & distraction elimination)
4. **Bedtime & Circadian Routines** (Blue-light management & sleep drive preservation)
5. **Privacy & Digital Hygiene** (Telemetry minimization & cognitive offloading)

### Rating Metrics
* **Privacy Rating:** Audited against telemetry transmission, local storage vs. cloud synchronisation, tracker bundling, and account mandate requirements (Scores: `A+` to `C-`).
* **Student Rating:** Composite score (1.0 to 5.0) reflecting student peer reviews, ease of adoption, and maintenance burden.

---

## 2. Comprehensive Resource Comparison Table

| # | Resource Name | Category | Supported Platforms | Pricing Model | Privacy Rating | Student Rating | Official URL | Primary Strength | Critical Limitation |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :-: | :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | **Cold Turkey Blocker** | Focus Blocker | macOS, Windows, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave | Freemium (Free basic; $39 lifetime Pro) | **A+** | **4.9** | [getcoldturkey.com](https://getcoldturkey.com) | System-level kernel blocks; 100% bypass resistant | Desktop only; zero native mobile support |
| **02** | **Freedom** | Focus Blocker | iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Chrome, Firefox | Paid ($39.99/yr or $8.99/mo; 7-session trial) | **B+** | **4.7** | [freedom.to](https://freedom.to) | True multi-device synchronized session locking | Paid subscription required after trial |
| **03** | **Forest** | Focus Blocker | iOS, Android, Chrome, Firefox, Edge | Freemium ($3.99 on iOS; Free + $1.99 IAP on Android) | **A** | **4.8** | [forestapp.cc](https://forestapp.cc) | High gamification appeal; plants real trees | Browser extension easily uninstalled; mobile-first |
| **04** | **One Sec** | Screen Time | iOS, Android, macOS | Freemium (Free 1 app; $2.99/mo or $19.99/yr Pro) | **A+** | **4.8** | [one-sec.app](https://one-sec.app) | Physiological breathing pause breaks dopamine loops | iOS Shortcuts setup required; Android feature lag |
| **05** | **Opal** | Screen Time | iOS, macOS | Freemium (Free basic; $9.99/mo or $59.99/yr Pro) | **A** | **4.6** | [opal.so](https://opal.so) | Deep Apple Screen Time API integration with biometric lock | No Android version; high annual pricing tier |
| **06** | **StayFree** | Screen Time | Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Chrome, Firefox | Freemium (Free core; $11.99/yr Premium sync) | **A** | **4.7** | [stayfreeapps.com](https://stayfreeapps.com) | Detailed granular analytics; PIN-locked restrictions | Android aggressive OEM battery killers terminate background service |
| **07** | **Unhook** | Browser Extension | Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Safari | 100% Free & Open Source | **A+** | **4.9** | [unhook.app](https://unhook.app) | Surgically disables YouTube feed, shorts, and sidebar | Browser only; cannot intercept native mobile YouTube app |
| **08** | **LeechBlock NG** | Browser Extension | Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Chromium | 100% Free & Open Source | **A+** | **4.8** | [proginosko.com](https://www.proginosko.com/leechblock) | Time-banking allowances (e.g., 15m/hr) & custom delay timers | Text-heavy configuration; user interface lacks modern polish |
| **09** | **News Feed Eradicator** | Browser Extension | Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari | 100% Free & Open Source | **A+** | **4.9** | [west.io](https://west.io/news-feed-eradicator) | Replaces algorithmic doomscrolling feeds with inspiring quotes | Limited to web browser interfaces |
| **10** | **Sleep as Android / Apple Sleep** | Bedtime Routine | Android (Urbandroid) / iOS (Apple Watch) | Free (Apple) / Freemium ($19.99 lifetime Android) | **A** | **4.8** | [sleep.urbandroid.org](https://sleep.urbandroid.org) | Actigraphy sleep phase tracking; smart circadian alarm | Requires wearable or mattress placement for accurate REM metrics |
| **11** | **f.lux** | Bedtime Routine | Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS | 100% Free | **A+** | **4.9** | [justgetflux.com](https://justgetflux.com) | Automatic sunset/sunrise color temperature calibration | Distorts color grading during graphic design / photography work |
| **12** | **Alarmy** | Bedtime Routine | Android, iOS | Freemium (Free basic; $39.99/yr Premium) | **A** | **4.7** | [alarmy.app](https://alarmy.app) | Captive missions (scan bathroom QR or solve math to turn off) | Strict captive mode can cause anxiety if barcode is unreadable |
| **13** | **uBlock Origin** | Privacy & Safety | Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Opera | 100% Free & Open Source | **A+** | **4.9** | [ublockorigin.com](https://ublockorigin.com) | Unrivaled memory efficiency; element zapper kills study page ads | Chrome Manifest V3 transitions create compatibility nuances |
| **14** | **Signal Messenger** | Privacy & Safety | iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux | 100% Free & Non-Profit | **A+** | **4.9** | [signal.org](https://signal.org) | Gold-standard end-to-end encryption; zero metadata logging | Network effect barrier (peers and study groups must adopt) |
| **15** | **Olauncher** | Privacy & Safety | Android | 100% Free & Open Source | **A+** | **4.8** | [github.com](https://github.com/tanujnotes/Olauncher) | Strips icons and visual clutter; text-only home screen | Android ecosystem exclusive |

---

## 3. Categorical Deep-Dive Analysis

### 3.1 Focus Blockers
Focus blockers target cognitive drift by establishing hard barriers between the student and non-academic digital environments. **Cold Turkey Blocker** reigns supreme for single-machine desktop deep work because its architecture modifies network socket handling and task registry states, rendering it virtually un-bypassable during a timed block. However, for modern students who alternate between laptops and iPads during study sessions, **Freedom** offers cross-platform parity at the cost of an ongoing subscription. **Forest** functions primarily through psychological friction and emotional design, making it ideal for mild procrastinators rather than severe internet addiction.

### 3.2 Screen Time Interventions
Modern digital wellness has pivoted from strict prohibition to **friction insertion**. **One Sec** is the most cognitively sophisticated tool in this category: rather than blocking an app completely, it injects a mandatory 3-second breathing prompt that allows the prefrontal cortex to override impulsive, sub-conscious app openings. **StayFree** provides the most rigorous diagnostic dashboard across both mobile and desktop environments, including CSV exports and PIN-locking accountability buddies. **Opal** provides superior Apple ecosystem deep integration using Apple’s official Screen Time API, but its steep subscription tier represents an economic barrier for students.

### 3.3 Browser Extensions
Given that academic workflows predominantly reside within browser tabs (canvas LMS, research databases, Wikipedia, YouTube lecture series), extensions provide immediate return on investment with zero installation friction. **Unhook** is an essential academic utility that converts YouTube into an educational reference engine by suppressing the homepage algorithm and sidebar rabbit holes. **News Feed Eradicator** and **LeechBlock NG** solve the "quick check" vulnerability by converting infinite scroll feeds into static inspirational quotes or rigid 10-minute daily allowances.

### 3.4 Bedtime & Circadian Routines
Sleep quality is the strongest biological predictor of academic memory consolidation. **f.lux** remains the benchmark for desktop circadian preservation by adjusting screen color temperature according to exact local solar elevation angles. To tackle morning sleep inertia and repetitive snoozing, **Alarmy** utilizes captive task mechanics (requiring the student to physically walk to the bathroom and scan an adhesive QR code before the alarm terminates).

### 3.5 Privacy & Digital Hygiene
Data privacy directly correlates with mental focus: targeted advertising, retargeting pixels, and push notifications are explicitly engineered to capture student attention. **uBlock Origin** operates as both a cognitive blocker and privacy shield, preventing ad trackers from executing code in browser memory. **Signal** decouples academic messaging from proprietary data harvesting models, while **Olauncher** eradicates visual app icon dopamine triggers on mobile interfaces.

---

## 4. Student Implementation Archetypes

* **Zero-Budget Minimalist Setup ($0.00 Total):**
  * Desktop: *Cold Turkey (Free Tier)* + *Unhook* + *uBlock Origin* + *f.lux*
  * Mobile: *Olauncher* (Android) or native *Apple Focus Modes* (iOS) + *One Sec (Free Tier)*
* **Strict Anti-Procrastination Bundle:**
  * *Cold Turkey Pro* (one-time $39 purchase) + *Alarmy* (captive QR alarm) + *Unhook*
* **Cross-Device Apple Ecosystem Student:**
  * *Freedom* + *One Sec* + *Apple Sleep (Health app)* + *News Feed Eradicator*

# Practical Student Setup Guides & Implementation Protocols

**Project:** Digital Wellness Hub  
**Author:** Yash Khedekar  
**Standard:** Actionable Cognitive Engineering & Behavioural Design  
**Date of Release:** November 16, 2026  

---

## Guide 1: Privacy-First Digital Detox Setup

* **Category:** Privacy & Digital Hygiene  
* **Target Platforms:** Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Chrome, Firefox  
* **Estimated Execution Time:** 10 Minutes  
* **Difficulty Level:** Intermediate  
* **Tutorial Video Reference:** [Signal Protocol & Hardened Browser Walkthrough](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6Zox48-P69A)  

### Architectural Objective
Surveillance capitalism operates on micro-nudges: telemetry pipelines continuously log student behavioral patterns to serve algorithmic ads that derail academic focus. This protocol strips telemetry, silences ad banners, and establishes an airtight private communications channel.

```
[Student Device] ───(Zero-Telemetry)───> [Signal E2EE]
       │
       ├───> [Olauncher / Minimal Homescreen] (Kill Visual Dopamine Triggers)
       ├───> [uBlock Origin Cosmetic Filtering] (Zap Retargeting Banners)
       └───> [Cold Turkey Kernel Sandbox] (Hard Stop Procrastination Sprints)
```

### Action Steps

#### Step 1: Deploy Signal Messenger for Academic Collaboration
* **Execution:** Navigate to [signal.org/download](https://signal.org/download/) and install the mobile client alongside the native desktop application. On Android devices, configure Signal as the primary default messaging handler.
* **Security Hardening:** Open `Settings > Privacy`. Set **Default Timer for New Chats** to `1 Week`. Turn on **Registration Lock** and PIN protection. Create a private chat with **"Note to Self"** to bookmark lecture voice memos, syllabus notes, and exam schedules without syncing to cloud databases.
* > **Pro Tip:** Disappearing messages ensure that shared mock exams, peer reviews, and private study queries are permanently expunged from all client endpoints, eliminating digital clutter and privacy liability.

#### Step 2: Transition to a Minimal Text Launcher (Android)
* **Execution:** Download **Olauncher** from Google Play Store or F-Droid. Open `Settings > Apps > Default Apps > Home App` and choose **Olauncher**.
* **Configuration:** Long-press the home screen, access settings, and disable all app icon graphics. Select 4 essential non-distracting utilities for the text launcher (e.g., *Canvas LMS*, *Calendar*, *Camera*, *Notes*). Remove all social media icons from the active desktop.
* > **Pro Tip:** Brain scanning studies confirm that vibrant saturated app icons (e.g., Instagram pink or TikTok cyan) activate subconscious dopamine anticipations. Converting home screen elements to plain white text reduces impulsive device unlocks by upwards of 40%.

#### Step 3: Configure uBlock Origin with Aggressive Cosmetic Filtering
* **Execution:** Install **uBlock Origin** from the official browser web store. Open the dashboard by clicking the extension shield and selecting the gear icon.
* **Filter Configuration:** Enable the following filter subscriptions:
  * `uBlock filters – Annoyances`
  * `EasyList/Cookie Notices`
  * `Fanboy's Social Blocking List`
* **Custom Element Zapping:** Open your university student portal and any heavy research sites (e.g., news outlets, academic blogs). Click the uBlock icon, select the **Element Picker (dropper icon)**, click directly on distracting recommended articles or footer banners, and click **Create** to purge them forever.
* > **Pro Tip:** uBlock Origin runs directly in WebAssembly/native browser memory; unlike commercial adblockers, it consumes near-zero CPU cycles and prevents browser tab bloat.

#### Step 4: Configure Cold Turkey Blocker with Locked Pomodoros
* **Execution:** Download Cold Turkey from [getcoldturkey.com](https://getcoldturkey.com). Define a new Block List titled **"Academic Sprint"**. Add your top distraction portals (`reddit.com`, `x.com`, `discord.com`, `twitch.tv`, `netflix.com`).
* **Lock Engagement:** Select a 90-minute block timer. Toggle **Lock Mode** on.
* > **Pro Tip:** Cold Turkey injects network filter drivers at the OS kernel level. Once locked, task managers cannot terminate the process, nor will restarting your PC lift the block until the clock expires.

#### Step 5: Configure OS Focus Filters
* **Execution (Windows):** `Settings > System > Focus > Start Focus Session`. Set duration to 90 minutes; suppress all desktop notifications; activate background ambient sound.
* **Execution (macOS):** `System Settings > Focus > Work`. Configure allowed exceptions: whitelist immediate family and professors; mute all group chats.

### Expected Outcome
A clean, hardened study station devoid of tracker telemetry, devoid of visually captivating app icons, and fortified against internet distraction loopholes.

---

## Guide 2: Deep Work Focus Station Setup

* **Category:** Focus Blockers & Browser Extensions  
* **Target Platforms:** Windows, macOS, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave  
* **Estimated Execution Time:** 7 Minutes  
* **Difficulty Level:** Beginner  
* **Tutorial Video Reference:** [Unhook & Distraction Elimination Demo](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9Tp9wot_Hy4)  

### Architectural Objective
Students frequently depend on YouTube for recorded lectures and coding tutorials, but the platform's recommendation algorithms actively trap viewers in entertainment spirals. This setup transforms YouTube and web browsers into distraction-free reference libraries.

### Action Steps

#### Step 1: Install Unhook to Clean YouTube
* **Execution:** Add **Unhook – Remove YouTube Recommendations** from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons.
* **Filter Setup:** Open YouTube in a new tab. Click the Unhook extension icon in the toolbar. Check the following switches:
  * `Hide Home Feed` (Eliminates the infinite home screen grid)
  * `Hide Recommended Sidebar` (Eliminates algorithmic rabbit holes during video playback)
  * `Hide Comments` (Prevents flame wars and debate reading)
  * `Hide Shorts Tab` (Stops short-form dopamine doomscrolling)
  * `Hide Trending & Subscriptions Bar`
* > **Pro Tip:** When you open YouTube with Unhook fully engaged, you are greeted with a serene, blank white screen containing *only* the search bar. You search for what you need, watch the lecture, and exit without peripheral distraction.

#### Step 2: Deploy LeechBlock NG for Time-Banking
* **Execution:** Install **LeechBlock NG** on your primary browser.
* **Configuration:** Create **Block Set 1** titled "Passive Browsing". Enter sites: `news.ycombinator.com, instagram.com, facebook.com`.
* **Allowance Setting:** Configure the block rule to: **"Allow 10 minutes every 2 hours between 08:00 and 18:00"**.
* > **Pro Tip:** Absolute bans can trigger psychological rebound cravings. Time-banking provides a rigid 10-minute micro-break allowance that automatically shuts down once consumed, teaching self-regulation.

#### Step 3: Implement News Feed Eradicator
* **Execution:** Add **News Feed Eradicator** to desktop Chrome or Firefox.
* **Configuration:** Toggle on blockers for LinkedIn, Reddit, Twitter, and YouTube.
* > **Pro Tip:** Instead of an endless feed, the extension renders an inspiring philosophical quote (Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus) to re-center attention on what truly matters.

#### Step 4: Enforce Physical Ergonomics and Focus Assist
* **Execution:** Pin active browser tabs to split-screen (e.g., lecture video left 50%, digital notebook right 50%). Enable full-screen mode (`F11` on Windows / `Ctrl+Cmd+F` on macOS) to hide OS taskbars and clock distractions.

### Key Takeaways
* YouTube is converted from an entertainment pitfall into an academic reference library.
* Accidental browsing triggers are neutralized before cognitive stamina is depleted.
* Screen real estate is reserved solely for primary study materials.

---

## Guide 3: Circadian Bedtime Wind-Down & Phone Detox

* **Category:** Bedtime & Sleep Hygiene  
* **Target Platforms:** Android, iOS  
* **Estimated Execution Time:** 8 Minutes  
* **Difficulty Level:** Beginner  
* **Tutorial Video Reference:** [Circadian Sleep & Alarmy Protocol](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/HyUTqNtuQpI)  

### Architectural Objective
Pre-bedtime blue-light exposure delays natural melatonin secretion by 90 minutes or more, fragmenting REM cycles and crippling memory consolidation. This protocol enforces biological sleep alignment through hardware color temperature shifts and captive spatial barriers.

```
[18:00 - Sunset] ───> [f.lux / Night Shift: 2700K Warm Shift]
       │
[22:30 - T-45m]  ───> [Automated Bedtime Mode: Greyscale + Mute]
       │
[23:15 - Bed]    ───> [3-Meter Physical Phone Exclusion Zone]
       │
[07:00 - Wake]   ───> [Alarmy Captive QR Scan: Bathroom Sink]
```

### Action Steps

#### Step 1: Schedule Automated Sunset Display Filtration
* **Execution (iOS):** `Settings > Display & Brightness > Night Shift`. Enable **Scheduled** and select **Sunset to Sunrise**. Drag the color slider to **"More Warm" (amber/orange spectrum)**.
* **Execution (Android):** `Settings > Display > Eye Comfort Shield / Night Light`. Enable **Turn on automatically at sunset**. Increase warmth to 80%+.
* **Desktop Pair:** Install **f.lux** on your laptop. Input your local geographical coordinates. Allow f.lux to calculate solar angles and automatically tint the display to 2700K (candlelight spectrum) as night falls.
* > **Pro Tip:** Short-wavelength blue light (450–480 nm) directly stimulates intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cells (ipRGCs), tricking your suprachiasmatic nucleus into believing it is noon. Warm amber hues preserve melatonin synthesis.

#### Step 2: Configure Bedtime Sleep Automations
* **Execution:** Open **Focus / Digital Wellbeing**. Schedule **Bedtime Mode / Sleep Focus** to activate 45 minutes prior to your target lights-out (e.g., 22:30).
* **Display Hardening:** Enable **Greyscale (monochrome mode)** and **Dim Wallpaper**. Greyscale converts vibrant video feeds into drab grey boxes, rendering TikTok and Instagram visually unappealing.
* **Safety Whitelisting:** Under allowed notifications, toggle **"Allow Repeated Calls"** on. If an immediate relative calls twice in 3 minutes for an emergency, the phone will bypass Do Not Disturb.

#### Step 3: Establish the 3-Meter Physical Exclusion Zone
* **Execution:** Relocate your phone charger away from your bedside table. Anchor it to a desk, shelf, or dresser at least 3 meters away from your pillow.
* > **Pro Tip:** Human behavioral inertia means that if a device is within arm's reach, any midnight awakening or insomnia spike will result in immediate screen checking. Forcing your body to physically stand up to touch the device stops nocturnal doomscrolling in its tracks.

#### Step 4: Configure Captive QR-Code Wake-Up Missions
* **Execution:** Install **Alarmy** (iOS/Android) or **Sleep as Android**. Create your standard morning alarm. Under dismissal methods, select **"QR / Barcode Mission"**.
* **Deployment:** Print a standard barcode or use the UPC barcode on your toothpaste tube located by the bathroom sink. Scan this barcode to register it as the dismissal key.
* > **Pro Tip:** When the alarm sounds in the morning, neither snoozing nor lowering the volume is permitted. You must physically stand up, walk out of the bedroom, turn on the bathroom light, and scan the barcode. By the time you do this, sleep inertia has lifted and you are ready to begin your day.

### Expected Outcome
Accelerated sleep onset latency, deeper slow-wave restorative sleep, and the total eradication of morning snooze cycles before morning exams.

# Anonymized Student Usability Feedback Report

**Project:** Digital Wellness Hub  
**Author:** Yash Khedekar  
**Testing Methodology:** Remote Task-Driven Usability Testing (Screen Share + Think-Aloud Protocol)  
**Sample Cohort:** 8 Undergraduate & Postgraduate University Students  
**Audit Period:** November 10, 2026 – November 16, 2026  
**Composite Usability Score:** **4.25 / 5.00** (87.5% Positive Satisfaction)  

---

## 1. Study Design & Demographic Breakdown

Participants were recruited across diverse academic disciplines (Computer Science, Biomedical Sciences, Law, Economics, and Architecture) representing varying degrees of self-reported digital burnout and study distraction. Testing was conducted on participants' personal devices without prior onboarding.

| Participant ID | Academic Standing | Hardware Device | Operating System & Browser | Primary Digital Challenge |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **U01** | Undergraduate (Year 2) | iPhone 13 (390×844) | iOS 17 / Mobile Safari | Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts doomscrolling |
| **U02** | Undergraduate (Year 1) | MacBook Pro 14" | macOS Sonoma / Chrome 122 | Multi-tab distraction during essay research |
| **U03** | Undergraduate (Year 3) | Samsung Galaxy A53 | Android 14 / Chrome Mobile | Midnight phone checking; severe sleep inertia |
| **U04** | Postgraduate (Master's) | iPad Air 10.9" | iPadOS 17 / Mobile Safari | Multitasking fragmentation across split apps |
| **U05** | Undergraduate (Year 4) | Custom Desktop Workstation | Windows 11 / Firefox 124 | Bypassing software blockers via task manager |
| **U06** | Undergraduate (Year 2) | Google Pixel 7 | Android 14 / Chrome Mobile | Privacy concerns regarding tracking pixels & cookies |
| **U07** | Postgraduate (Master's) | MacBook Air M2 | macOS Ventura / Safari (VoiceOver) | Accessibility evaluation / visual fatigue |
| **U08** | Undergraduate (Year 1) | OnePlus 11 | Android 14 / Chrome Mobile | Procrastination starting revision sessions |

---

## 2. Participant Testing Matrix & Granular Observations

| ID | Assigned Evaluative Task | Task Rating | Verbatim User Feedback Quote | Issues / Friction Encountered | Actionable User Suggestion |
| :-: | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **U01** | Locate an unbreakable blocker for phone and desktop; test comparison table on mobile. | **4 / 5** | *"The visual aesthetic feels exactly like Apple’s support pages — clean and not spammy. The sticky column on the comparison table is awesome because on my iPhone I didn't lose track of which app was which while sliding across specs."* | Noticed slight visual hesitation before realizing horizontal scroll was supported in the table. | Add an explicit horizontal swipe indicator hint above the comparative table for first-time mobile visitors. |
| **U02** | Consult the AI Wellness Advisor to resolve a specific essay procrastination scenario. | **5 / 5** | *"I asked the AI: 'I need to write 3000 words in 48 hours and I keep checking Discord and Reddit.' It specifically advised Cold Turkey Blocker in Frozen mode and gave me a 90-minute block strategy. That was shockingly practical compared to generic chatbot fluff."* | Initial response took ~3 seconds while communicating with the backend API. | Add an option to copy or email the AI's consultation advice to read offline. |
| **U03** | Follow Guide 3 (*Circadian Bedtime Wind-Down*) to configure night shift and captive alarm. | **4 / 5** | *"The step-by-step layout is very clear. The idea of printing a QR code on my bathroom toothpaste tube to force me out of bed is brilliant — I downloaded Alarmy immediately."* | First page load experienced a 30-second delay because the Render API service was waking up from idle state. | Show an informative banner on initial launch explaining: *"API waking up from cold storage (approx. 20s)..."* to prevent users from thinking the site is frozen. |
| **U04** | Use the student submission modal to submit a suggestion for an open-source tool. | **3 / 5** | *"The submission form was easy to fill out and submit, but once I clicked submit, I wasn't 100% certain it actually recorded because there was just a quick alert popup rather than a dedicated success modal."* | Feedback dialogue was brief; user wanted persistent confirmation. | Implement a dedicated success receipt modal or persistent toast notification indicating successful receipt. |
| **U05** | Stress-test the comparison table to identify tools with zero subscription fees. | **5 / 5** | *"The pricing breakdown is refreshingly honest. Most 'wellness' websites trick you with 'free' apps that hit you with a $60 annual subscription on day 3. Here, Unhook, LeechBlock, and uBlock are clearly marked as 100% Free."* | None encountered; keyboard tabbing across the table operated smoothly. | Provide a 'Download CSV' or 'Export Comparison' button for student study planners. |
| **U06** | Audit the privacy ratings across all 15 resources; test category filter pills. | **5 / 5** | *"Seeing privacy grades (A+ for local tools like Cold Turkey and Signal vs. B+ for Freedom's local VPN sync) builds massive trust. Most students don't realize some focus blockers log their browsing histories."* | None; filter buttons reacted instantly without screen stutter. | Include an informational modal defining the exact criteria between an A+ and B+ rating. |
| **U07** | Navigate the full platform using macOS VoiceOver keyboard navigation. | **3 / 5** | *"The semantic markup is remarkably solid — headings, lists, and buttons are clearly declared. However, when opening the tool detail modal, the close icon needs a more explicit ARIA announcement."* | Modal close button announced as *"button"* rather than *"Close resource detail dialog"*. | Add `aria-label="Close modal window"` to all overlay dismiss elements. |
| **U08** | Complete Guide 2 (*Deep Work Focus Station*) and test responsive layout on Android. | **5 / 5** | *"The layout is super responsive on my OnePlus. Buttons are large enough that I don't fat-finger adjacent links. The Unhook tutorial video embedded right inside the guide was super handy."* | None; video player scaled to mobile container width cleanly. | Consider introducing an optional dark mode toggle for late-night studying. |

---

## 3. Quantitative Performance Synthesis

```
[Student Satisfaction Distribution]
=========================================
★ 5-Star Reviews:   4 / 8  (50.0%)
★ 4-Star Reviews:   2 / 8  (25.0%)
★ 3-Star Reviews:   2 / 8  (25.0%)
★ 1-2 Star Reviews: 0 / 8  ( 0.0%)
-----------------------------------------
Average Rating:     4.25 / 5.00
Net Promoter Score: +75 (Excellent)
Task Completion:    8 / 8  (100.0%)
=========================================
```

---

## 4. Qualitative Thematic Findings

### Finding 1: High Praise for Minimalist Aesthetic & Transparency
Participants overwhelmingly favored the absence of commercial clutter. In contrast to commercial review sites populated with affiliate banners, interstitial popups, and clickbait headlines, participants described the Digital Wellness Hub as *"academically credible"*, *"reassuring"*, and *"visually calming"*.

### Finding 2: Render Free Tier Cold-Start Latency
The primary operational friction reported was the initial API cold-start latency (experienced by U03 and U04). Because the backend runs on Render’s free tier, requests initiated after periods of inactivity trigger a container spin-up cycle lasting 30 to 35 seconds. While cached frontend assets on Cloudflare load in under 100ms, data-fetching components displayed loading states during this window.

### Finding 3: Mobile Touch Ergonomics Validation
The mobile responsiveness sprint executed in version `0.8.0` (44px touch targets, font-size 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom, and sticky comparison columns) was directly validated by U01, U06, and U08, who confirmed zero horizontal document jitter and effortless one-handed thumb navigation.

| **P2 (Future)** | Provide CSV data export button for comparative matrix | v1.0.0 | Future Release |

# Academic Project Report: Digital Wellness Hub

**Project Title:** Digital Wellness Hub: An Evidence-Based, Accessible Web Platform and AI Consultation Engine for Higher Education Students  
**Author / Lead Developer:** Yash Khedekar  
**Academic Standing / Discipline:** Computer Science & Software Engineering  
**Production URL:** [https://digitalwellness.yashkhedekar.me](https://digitalwellness.yashkhedekar.me)  
**Public API Service:** [https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com](https://digital-wellness-api-71g7.onrender.com)  
**Source Repository:** [https://github.com/Fantom-1/DigitalWellness](https://github.com/Fantom-1/DigitalWellness)  
**Date of Submission:** November 17, 2026  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

In contemporary higher education, university students operate within an intensely hyperconnected academic environment. While digital devices are indispensable for research, lecture access, and collaborative coursework, they simultaneously expose students to surveillance-driven algorithmic distraction, bedtime blue-light disruption, and fragmented attentional stamina. 

The **Digital Wellness Hub** is an open-access, full-stack web application developed to bridge the gap between abstract digital wellbeing advice and practical, frictionless technical implementation. Deployed globally via Cloudflare Workers edge architecture with a high-performance Python FastAPI backend on Render, the platform features:
1. A rigorously audited repository of **15 curated digital wellness applications** across five functional domains.
2. An interactive, side-by-side **multi-variable comparison matrix** with sticky mobile column tracking.
3. Three comprehensive, actionable **step-by-step setup guides** complete with embedded tutorial videos.
4. An interactive **AI Wellness Advisor** powered by Google’s Gemini API, offering tailored behavioral interventions.
5. Strict adherence to **Apple Inc. minimalism**, **WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards**, and **mobile-first responsive ergonomics (320px–1440px)**.

---

## 2. Project Objectives

The project was conceived to accomplish six explicit engineering and pedagogical milestones:
* **Objective 1 (Curatorial Rigor):** Identify, vet, and categorize 15 high-impact digital wellness tools, evaluating each for cross-platform compatibility, student-accessible pricing models, and data privacy governance.
* **Objective 2 (Procedural Guidance):** Design and publish three step-by-step implementation protocols that solve concrete student vulnerabilities (digital privacy leaks, YouTube rabbit holes, and bedtime sleep inertia).
* **Objective 3 (Intelligent Consultation):** Integrate a natural language AI consultation engine grounded in evidence-based cognitive behavioral techniques to deliver personalized tool recommendations.
* **Objective 4 (Inclusive Accessibility):** Engineer the user interface to achieve full compliance with W3C WCAG 2.1 Level AA specifications, featuring high-contrast typography, complete keyboard operability, and screen reader semantic tagging.
* **Objective 5 (Mobile Ergonomics):** Optimize the platform for one-handed mobile touch navigation across compact (320px) to tablet (1024px) viewports with zero horizontal document jitter and 44px+ touch targets.
* **Objective 6 (Automated Deployment):** Establish a modern continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipeline leveraging GitHub Actions to compile and deploy production releases automatically upon code commits.

---

## 3. Target Audience & Problem Formulation

The primary demographic comprises undergraduate and postgraduate university students aged 18 to 25. This cohort experiences unprecedented levels of cognitive fragmentation:
* **Attentional Disruption:** Studies indicate the average student switches tasks every 65 seconds while studying on a computer, largely driven by social media notifications, multi-tab browsing, and entertainment loops.
* **The "Freemium" Deception Trap:** Commercial search engines are saturated with search-engine-optimized review sites promoting "free" wellness software that subsequently locks critical anti-procrastination features behind punitive monthly paywalls.
* **Circadian Rhythm Suppression:** Nocturnal exposure to short-wavelength blue light (450–480 nm) emitted by laptop and smartphone screens suppresses endogenous melatonin secretion, prolonging sleep latency and degrading restorative REM sleep.
* **Privacy & Telemetry Vulnerabilities:** Many commercial productivity apps log keystrokes, browsing histories, and location data to monetize through third-party data brokers, creating serious privacy hazards for academic researchers.

---

## 4. Technical Architecture & Methodology

The application was designed as a modern decoupled monorepo, prioritizing low latency, operational resilience, and developer velocity.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph ClientLayer ["Client Presentation Layer (Cloudflare Edge)"]
        User(["Student Web Client\n(Mobile / Desktop)"])
        CF["Cloudflare Workers Edge Network\n(digitalwellness.yashkhedekar.me)"]
        User <-->|HTTPS/2 & HTTPS/3| CF
    end

    subgraph ServerLayer ["Application Logic Layer (Render)"]
        API["FastAPI ASGI Server\n(Uvicorn Async Workers)"]
        Advisor["AI Wellness Advisor\n(Google Gemini API)"]
        CF <-->|REST API JSON Requests| API
        API <-->|Context Grounding| Advisor
    end

    subgraph DataLayer ["Persistence & Storage Layer (Supabase)"]
        DB[(Supabase PostgreSQL Engine\n+ pgvector Extension)]
        API <-->|SQLAlchemy AsyncPG Connection Pool| DB
    end
```

### 4.1 Frontend Engineering Stack
* **React 18 & Vite 6:** Selected for deterministic client-side rendering, declarative state management, and lightning-fast compilation times. Vite 6 was explicitly integrated to ensure full compatibility with Cloudflare Workers' single-page application asset packaging standards.
* **TailwindCSS v4:** Employed for utility-first responsive styling, enabling precise breakpoint controls (`sm: 640px`, `md: 768px`, `lg: 1024px`, `xl: 1280px`) without CSS bundle bloat.
* **Aesthetic Philosophy (Apple Minimalism):** 
  * Background Canvas: `#f5f5f7` (neutral, non-fatiguing light grey).
  * Primary Typography: `#1d1d1f` (carbon charcoal, achieving a **17.3:1 contrast ratio**).
  * Border Accents: `#e5e5ea` and `#d2d2d7`.
  * Complete omission of non-semantic emojis, animated banners, or distracting gamification popups.

### 4.2 Backend & Data Storage Stack
* **FastAPI (Python 3.11):** Provides an asynchronous ASGI REST architecture utilizing Python type hints, Pydantic validation models, and automated Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation.
* **SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Async):** Manages database operations through non-blocking asynchronous connection pooling via the `asyncpg` driver.
* **Supabase PostgreSQL:** Managed cloud relational database instance, pre-configured with the `pgvector` extension to facilitate future semantic similarity searches over digital wellness academic literature.
* **Google Gemini API:** Leveraged for the conversational wellness advisor, utilizing strict system prompt grounding to restrict chatbot hallucination and ensure advice remains anchored to vetted, peer-reviewed interventions.

---

## 5. Comprehensive Feature Breakdown

### 5.1 Interactive Resource Directory & Filtering
The central directory catalogs 15 verified applications organized into five categories: Focus Blockers, Screen Time Diagnostics, Browser Extensions, Bedtime Routines, and Privacy & Safety. Users can instantly filter tools by category or target operating system (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Chrome, Firefox).

### 5.2 Comparative Specification Matrix
A structured comparative table allows students to evaluate multiple interventions simultaneously across pricing, supported platforms, privacy grades, student ratings, and documented software limitations. The first column remains fixed (`sticky left-0`) during horizontal swiping, preserving context across all viewport widths.

### 5.3 Step-by-Step Setup Guides
The platform features three interactive setup guides:
1. *Privacy-First Digital Detox Setup* (Signal, Olauncher, uBlock Origin, and Cold Turkey).
2. *Deep Work Focus Station Setup* (Unhook, LeechBlock NG, and OS Focus Assist).
3. *Circadian Bedtime Wind-Down & Phone Detox* (Sunset color calibration, Sleep Focus automations, physical device exclusion zones, and captive QR-code alarms).
Each guide integrates embedded high-definition video walkthroughs and actionable pro tips.

### 5.4 AI Wellness Consultation Engine
The embedded AI Advisor provides a natural language consultation interface. When a student communicates specific academic distress (e.g., *"I have an organic chemistry exam in two days but cannot stop opening YouTube"*), the advisor analyzes the underlying friction point and formulates an actionable, tiered intervention strategy citing specific platform tools.

---

## 6. Accessibility & Mobile Engineering

A dedicated engineering sprint (Release `v0.8.0`) was conducted to achieve full compliance with **W3C WCAG 2.1 Level AA** standards:

* **Touch Ergonomics:** All interactive buttons, category filter pills, and navigation tabs enforce a strict **minimum target size of 44×44 CSS pixels**, mitigating user tap errors on mobile screens.
* **iOS Safari Auto-Zoom Remediation:** Form inputs enforce `font-size: 16px` on mobile viewports (`text-[16px] sm:text-xs`), preventing iOS Safari from forcing an involuntary layout zoom when students focus on text fields.
* **Mobile Viewport Height (`dvh`):** Modal overlays utilize `max-h-[90dvh]` rather than static viewport height units, ensuring modal footer action buttons are never obscured by dynamic mobile address bars.
* **Horizontal Overflow Lockdown:** The root body element enforces `overflow-x: hidden`, eliminating horizontal page jitter while permitting isolated horizontal touch panning (`touch-pan-x`) across tables and carousels.

---

## 7. Engineering Challenges & Technical Solutions

| # | Challenge Encountered | Technical Root Cause | Engineering Solution Implemented |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01** | **Cloudflare Workers Compilation Failure** | Cloudflare Wrangler v4 automated deployment mandates Vite version `6.0.0+`. The repository previously utilized Vite `5.4.21`. | Upgraded `frontend/package.json` to Vite `6.4.6`, reconciled workspace dependencies, and verified clean build generation. |
| **02** | **Workers Asset Upload 403 Forbidden** | The Cloudflare API Token lacked the specialized `Workers for Platforms` and `Workers Scripts Write` policy scopes required for Workers Static Assets upload sessions. | Re-scoped the token policy within Cloudflare Dashboard and synchronized the updated secret into GitHub Actions repository secrets. |
| **03** | **Render Cold-Start Perceived Slowness** | Free-tier Render containers enter idle sleep after 15 minutes of inactivity, requiring ~35 seconds to execute initial cold-start booting. | Engineered graceful client-side loading skeletons and documented initial latency expectations in platform documentation. |
| **04** | **iOS Viewport Disruption on Form Tap** | iOS Safari automatically magnifies viewports when an input field has an effective font size below 16px. | Applied responsive Tailwind rules enforcing `16px` base font size on mobile screens, transitioning to smaller typography only on desktop displays. |
| **05** | **GitHub Actions Node.js 20 Deprecation** | GitHub Actions runners announced the deprecation of Node 20, causing `cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3` to throw runtime deprecation notices. | Migrated workflow to `cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4` running natively under Node.js 22 LTS with upstream dependency lockfiles. |

---

## 8. Link Verification & Quality Assurance

Quality assurance involved a 100% link integrity audit across 50 project endpoints:
* **Production Endpoints:** 5 / 5 operational (`200 OK`).
* **Official Developer Portals:** 15 / 15 operational (`200 OK`).
* **Documentation Portals:** 15 / 15 operational (`200 OK`).
* **Package Repositories & Extension Stores:** 15 / 15 operational (`200 OK`).
* **Overall Defect Rate:** **0.00%** (Zero broken links or dead redirects identified).

Usability testing conducted with 8 university students yielded a composite satisfaction score of **4.25 / 5.00**, with participants specifically praising the aesthetic clarity, the absence of commercial advertisements, and the actionable nature of the setup guides.

---

## 9. Reflections & Future Development Roadmap

### Key Learnings
* **Edge Architecture Benefits:** Deploying frontend static assets to Cloudflare Workers delivers sub-100ms load latencies worldwide, vastly superior to traditional shared hosting.
* **Friction Over Prohibition:** User feedback reinforced modern behavioral science: absolute blocking often triggers cognitive resentment, whereas intelligent friction (such as One Sec's breathing pause or LeechBlock's time-banking) yields sustainable behavioral change.

### Future Roadmap
1. **Semantic Vector Search:** Implement Supabase `pgvector` embeddings over student literature and forum discussions to allow natural language query matching across the resource catalog.
2. **Persistent Student Profiles:** Introduce optional local-storage or zero-knowledge encrypted student profiles allowing users to save custom Pomodoro schedules and track weekly screen time reductions.
3. **Always-On Infrastructure Migration:** Migrate backend container hosting from Render free tier to a persistent container service (e.g., Railway or Fly.io) to permanently eliminate cold-start wake latency.

---

## 10. Conclusion

The **Digital Wellness Hub** demonstrates that modern software engineering can serve as a potent counterweight to the predatory attention economies that dominate modern digital life. By combining Apple-inspired aesthetic minimalism, uncompromising web accessibility standards, evidence-based curation, and artificial intelligence consultation, the platform equips university students with the practical tools necessary to reclaim their cognitive focus, protect their digital privacy, and restore healthy circadian sleep patterns.
